## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the correct template (`templates/agent-template.md` or `templates/skill-template.md`)
- [ ] Every section in `agent.md` is filled in (no placeholder text)
- [ ] The example input/output is real and produces the described output
- [ ] No sensitive data included (no real crash logs with PII, no API keys)
- [ ] README agent table updated (if a new agent was added)
- [ ] The agent or skill works with at least one common LLM (Claude, GPT-4, etc.)
